reviews.title: Can't be trusted
reviews.text: Users cannot trust the accuracy of an app which voluntarily changed the name of the Gulf of Mexico and Lake Ontario on its map to the Gulf of America and Lake America, neither of which are official changes recognized by anyone other than the Trump administration.

reviews.title: Gave in to trump
reviews.text: It’s Gulf of Mexico and Lake Ontario. I have no use for you maga racists.

reviews.title: Random Renaming of Geographical features
reviews.text: Apparently, quake feed is a MAGA supporting organization and has renamed Lake Ontario as Lake America.  Just because Quake Feed has poor judgment, doesn’t mean I have to aid and abet them.  It’s how the wall of democracy erodes, one brick at a time.  I am deleting my app and subscription.

reviews.title: Stop selling and let me try it out!
Names in App Arbitrarily in region’s Native Language
reviews.text: Why?   I can’t read Farsi, Mandarin, OR Russian so why have the names and landmarks in those languages?  Is this a global app?  Why are the names on the African Continent mostly in English yet Ukraine is indistinguishable unless you are Carmen Sandiego.  If I wanted a roadmap I’d use Waze for naming accuracy.  Also, the quake alerts locations  instantly translate to English AFTER the fact.  Not helpful or nice
